name: Kamehameha
primary:
From Dragon Ball. "Ka… me… ha… me…" — you gather a glowing ball of energy for 1.5 s, then release a thick blue beam that follows your aim for 1.2 s, up to 32 blocks. Every 0.2 s everyone in the beam:
• Damage 1 ❤ arcane + 0.5 ❤ lightning (×2 on wet)
• Pushed along the beam
self_description: After the charge the beam fires straight down and launches you high into the air with slow falling for 5 s. Whoever stands below takes the beam's damage.
